_comment: Evidence -> control references and status thresholds. Titles are our own wording, never the standards' text. NIS2 art. 21(2) letters and the 2024/2690 annex sections were checked against the official text (Publications Office of the EU, CELEX 32022L2555 and 32024R2690) on 2026-11-13. Rules are evaluated in order, the first match wins; a rule whose metric is null is skipped; no match gives 'default'.

21(2)(e).en: Security in acquisition, development and maintenance, vulnerability handling

source.it: Inventario SentinelNet e versioni rilevate dal triage.
source.en: SentinelNet inventory and versions read by triage.

source.it: Correlazione CVE (NVD, CISA KEV) sulle versioni rilevate.
source.en: CVE correlation (NVD, CISA KEV) on the detected versions.

source.it: Storico delle configurazioni salvate per apparato.
Baseline di configurazione del tenant e storico delle versioni.
source.en: Tenant configuration baseline and version history.

source.it: Esecuzioni NetSec Audit salvate nello storico (ultima per apparato e benchmark).
source.en: NetSec Audit runs saved in history (latest per device and benchmark).

source.it: Zone di rete salvate sulla mappa e decisioni sui collegamenti.
source.en: Network zones saved on the map and link decisions.

note.it: Le zone e le decisioni sui collegamenti sono quelle salvate. La ricerca dei possibili bypass del firewall si fa sulla mappa (dipende dalla topologia disegnata) e non entra in questo report: lo stato resta 'parziale' finche' non e' verificata li'.
note.en: Zones and link decisions are the saved ones. The search for possible firewall bypasses runs on the map (it depends on the drawn topology) and is not part of this report: the status stays 'partial' until it is checked there.

source.it: Eventi syslog ricevuti nel periodo e retention configurata.
source.en: Syslog events received in the period and configured retention.

source.it: Utenti di SentinelNet con accesso al tenant; verifica della catena del registro di audit.
source.en: SentinelNet users with access to the tenant; audit log chain check.

title.it: Accessi a SentinelNet e registro di audit

out_of_scope.en: Supply chain security and supplier relationships.

out_of_scope.en: Assessment of the effectiveness of risk-management measures.

Politiche sull'uso della crittografia (il report mostra solo la configurazione degli apparati).
out_of_scope.en: Policies on the use of cryptography (the report only shows device configuration).

out_of_scope.it: Autenticazione a piu' fattori e comunicazioni protette. Il login di SentinelNet non ha l'autenticazione a piu' fattori.
out_of_scope.en: Multi-factor authentication and secured communications. SentinelNet's own login has no multi-factor authentication.
